context: Guards that a missing excat plugin is reported, not self-repaired. Installing excat is one-time human machine setup; SKILL.md forbids a git clone or npm install at run time. The agent's job is to run --check, surface the printed fix and the setup link, and stop. This eval previously rewarded the opposite (autonomous clone + install:all + npx . smoke-check) and was rewritten to match the skill.

checklist.name: Detects not-installed and stops
checklist.description: The agent recognizes the plugin is not installed at all (not merely disabled) and stops before doing any design-token work.

checklist.name: Does not try to install excat itself
checklist.description: The agent does NOT run git clone, npm install / npm run install:all, or npx . via the Bash tool, and does not offer to do so. Attempting any autonomous install of the plugin fails this item outright.

checklist.name: Uses --check as the readiness signal
checklist.description: The agent runs scripts/rebrand/extract-brand.mjs --check and reports its output, rather than asserting readiness from claude plugin list, a file-existence check, or the operator's word.

checklist.name: Hands over the fix and the link
checklist.description: The agent gives the human the fix --check printed and points at excat's setup instructions (the aem-experience-catalyst CLI setup URL) and/or docs/excat-setup.md, rather than describing the problem without a next step.

checklist.name: No hand-rolled rebrand
checklist.description: The agent does not edit styles.css, sweep hardcoded colors, or rewrite content as a substitute for the design skill.

checklist.name: Rebrand left blocked
checklist.description: The rebrand phase is left blocked pending the plugin being installed.
